scope: Final visible Draft, exact source/article/action/deployed-JSON bytes, generation and publication timing, DL-6 backup coverage and restore evidence, Fleet Runner PR state and dependency ordering, NS-5/NS-10/NS-11 decision scope, live versus legacy telemetry sources, existing review PR dispositions, held action custody, and current review registry/discovery state. Read-only review; no article revision or acceptance, finding disposition, action admission or settlement, readiness, merge, workflow dispatch, runtime, or scheduling authority.

findings.title: Backup coverage excludes files the article says are included
findings.location: The summary and lines 11 and 17 say every SQLite fact ledger and classified data file, and all other data files, are backed up.
findings.explanation: The pinned backup contract excludes the credentials file, restore-drill scratch roots, and specified SQLite WAL, SHM, and journal files. It does not provide the exception-free coverage claimed by the article.
findings.correction: Say the backup covers the classified data-root inventory subject to its documented credential, scratch-root, and SQLite side-file exclusions.

findings.title: The restore drill does more than hash checking and a real run was documented
findings.location: Line 17 defines a pass as restored-tree hashes matching, while retained context on line 81 says no real production-data drill is documented.
findings.explanation: The drill also replays restored ledgers, rebuilds the dataset, and compares the TS-0 version and labels bytes. BookcaseDiscovery #89 records a real first backup and restore drill with identical replay and dataset results.
findings.correction: Describe verified object reads plus ledger replay and byte-identical dataset reconstruction, and acknowledge the recorded real-data drill with its stated limits.

findings.title: The six-PR count, universal dependency chain, and ADR blocker are false
findings.location: The summary and lines 11, 49, and 59 call all six PRs Draft, put all six behind core #584/#586, and require ADR #590 acceptance before #589/#90 merge.
findings.explanation: Core #590 is non-Draft and based on main. The other PRs record their own immediate stack bases, and #589/#90 do not establish accepted #590 as a merge prerequisite.
findings.correction: Report five Draft PRs plus non-Draft #590, preserve each actual immediate base and owner/review gate, and do not invent ADR acceptance as a merge prerequisite.

findings.title: The article parks NS-10 and NS-11 after recording them complete
findings.location: Line 55 says NS-10 and NS-11 are closed, but line 57 and the held capture-session candidate say they are parked or gated by NS-5.
findings.explanation: The NS-11 report records a passed development keep rule and separately labels the zero-case NS-5 degraded tier insufficient data, neither go nor no-go. That missing sample does not reopen completed NS-10/NS-11 work.
findings.correction: Keep NS-10 and NS-11's documented development work complete while reporting the separate NS-5 degraded-tier decision as unavailable pending 14 qualifying cases.

findings.title: The live skill-usage stream is not the frozen legacy file
findings.location: Line 61 and retained context on line 80 say the skill telemetry stream has been frozen since 2026-05-12.
findings.explanation: Current collection makes the live skill-dispositions ledger primary. Only the legacy skill-telemetry.jsonl fallback is documented as frozen on that date.
findings.correction: Identify the exact source and freshness timestamp behind each figure; do not generalize the legacy fallback's freeze date to the live dispositions stream.

findings.title: The review PRs have a documented Draft and open-finding disposition
findings.location: Line 63 and retained context say daily-logger #526, #529, and #530 have no known merge blockers or documented disposition.
findings.explanation: Each is a Draft review-data proposal whose body preserves open findings and explicitly stops before article revision, acceptance, readiness, and merge. That is a documented bounded-review state, not evidence of merge readiness.
findings.correction: Describe them as open Draft review proposals with open findings awaiting supervised editorial disposition; do not infer merge readiness or a process gap from age alone.

findings.title: The mtime and size heuristic's immutability premise is not established
findings.location: Line 37 says all data-root files are append-only JSONL caches or immutable model weights and that code contracts enforce this property.
findings.explanation: The pinned inventory includes SQLite facts, originals, labels, datasets, derived caches, catalogs, models, and unclassified files. The reviewed evidence documents the same-size/same-mtime corruption limit but contains no exhaustive write-path audit proving the article's binary premise.
findings.correction: Present the skip heuristic and its documented corruption limit without claiming every included file is append-only JSONL or immutable weights unless a pinned exhaustive audit proves it.
